notes.title: RNG JAM is an upcoming NBA Jam inspired arcade-styled basketball game with roguelite chaos
notes.content:
With an interface that looks rather inspired by Balatro in many parts, RNG JAM from bryanthaboi will bring arcade styled basketball with roguelite chaos.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/rng-jam-is-an-upcoming-nba-jam-inspired-arcade-styled-basketball-game-with-roguelite-chaos/
